name: 11577 · Roslyn Hts, NY
findings: ZIP 11577 (Roslyn Hts) has 82 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11577 (Roslyn Hts) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 11577 (Roslyn Hts) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.1 times the typical level).
